capabilities: Set an ICO-format badge for the current vault
Replace the badge with the Vault Badge: Replace badge command
Store the chosen badge inside the vault
disambiguation: Not an icon theme or file-icon plugin; it only sets one badge overlay for the current vault via a command.
extras: README is brief: it explains the command and ICO format requirement but gives no screenshots or examples; it recommends Lucide or OpenSVG as icon sources.
problem: Multiple Obsidian vaults look identical in the Windows toolbar, making it hard to tell which one is which.

requires.name: Windows (overlay is described for the Windows toolbar)

summary: Vault badge plugin that adds an ICO icon overlay to the current vault so it is easier to distinguish in the Windows toolbar.
